data.text:
PELIKULAYA: Encounters — Grateful our stories met. 🌈

The Film Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP) proudly presents PELIKULAYA: Encounters—a vibrant celebration of  LGBTQ+ stories, uniquely told, yet universally felt.

This year’s edition opens a space where everyone belongs—featuring a powerful lineup of queer cinema, from global classics to homegrown Filipino narratives.

Join us for film screenings, meaningful conversations with acclaimed filmmakers, and moments that honor diversity, community, and the freedom to be.
Catch our first screenings from JUNE 21 to 29 and celebrate Pride with Pelikulaya: Encounters!

FILM LINEUP:
- Young Hearts
- Portrait of a Lady on Fire
- Pierce (SM North Edsa ONLY)

PARTNER CINEMAS:
- SM North Edsa
- SM MOA
- SM Manila
- SM Megamall

GET YOUR TICKETS HERE!
https://t.co/kbDmjqbMFn

Want to see more? Keep an eye out for more screenings to come! 👀

Happy Pride Month, mga mahal!

#FDCP #MovieOn #PhilippineCinema #PelikulayaEncounters #PrideMonth

data.text:
IN PHOTOS: Various organizations join a protest march starting from the Manila Film Center to the Senate of the Philippines today, June 11. The rally called on the impeachment court to impartially proceed with the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte.

This mobilization marks the third and last day of the mass actions for the “Day of Action for Truth and Accountability,” organized by Tindig Pilipinas, Akbayan, and other groups.

Photos by Finomena Chang
